# MarketScale

> MarketScale is a B2B media and content platform that empowers organizations to create, manage, and distribute user-generated content at scale.

MarketScale provides a comprehensive suite of tools for B2B companies across multiple departments—from marketing and sales to HR and DevOps—enabling community-generated content creation, video collaboration, and thought leadership. The platform serves diverse industries including healthcare, construction, education, and energy.

## Key Topics

- User Generated Content (UGC)
- B2B Marketing
- Content Creation & Distribution
- Video Editing & Collaboration
- Community Building
- Thought Leadership
- Employee Engagement
- Content Management Platform
- Virtual Events
- AI-Powered Tools
- DevOps & Developer Engagement
- Customer Engagement
- Online Learning
- Healthcare Compliance
- Agency Solutions

- [MarketScale Homepage](https://marketscale.com): MarketScale homepage: B2B media platform for community-generated content

- [MarketScale Studio](https://www.company.marketscale.com/studio): MarketScale Studio: video creation & collaboration platform for B2B
